auth_model: Project-specific authorization is not defined in the starter; no credential, account, or secret class is approved.
endpoint_or_authority_scope: No external endpoint, hosted collector, MCP, A2A, OpenAI, or remote authority scope is approved by the starter template.
redaction_or_boundary_model: Only a future project ADR can define redaction and export boundaries; raw payloads, prompts, transcripts, secrets, runtime paths, and tool output remain excluded.
cost_or_stop_boundary: No remote probe, retry, send action, or cost-bearing operation is allowed until a project ADR or equivalent contract is adopted.
decision: Keep remote interop sample collection blocked until the new project records its own ADR or contract.
note: Starter contract only records the blocked state; it does not prove external collector, hosted trace, MCP, A2A, or OpenAI interop.

auth_model: Project-specific agent authority is not defined in the starter; subagents, workers, handoffs, or tool outputs cannot expand authority.
endpoint_or_authority_scope: No remote agent, A2A endpoint, hosted worker, external send, deployment, secret operation, or autonomous retry surface is approved by the starter.
redaction_or_boundary_model: Only bounded incident summaries may be designed later; raw transcript, prompt, secret, raw tool output, runtime path, and external payload storage remain excluded.
cost_or_stop_boundary: No cascading execution sample, retry loop, or delegation experiment is allowed until a project ADR defines stop and budget boundaries.
decision: Keep cascade-stop sample collection blocked until the new project records its own ADR or contract.
note: Starter contract only records the blocked state; it does not prove multi-agent runtime, A2A, hosted interop, or automatic cascade enforcement.
